metaTitle: Custom Safety Colored Fleece | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom safety colored fleece for high-visibility branding. Perfect for safety managers and bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Safety colored fleece combines the warmth and comfort of fleece with high-visibility hues like hi-vis yellow and orange. Ideal for construction crews, outdoor workers, and safety teams, these custom fleece jackets ensure your crew stays seen and warm on the job. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for durable branding that stands out in low-light conditions.
heroAltText: Custom safety colored fleece jackets in hi-vis yellow and orange with embroidered logos for team branding
